state.description: Branches keyed `owner/repo:name` with their head sha and optional protection rule.
Issue and pull-request conversation comments keyed `owner/repo#<number>:<id zero-padded 10>`.
Commits keyed `owner/repo@sha`; each carries its full flat tree snapshot (path -> blob) and the file diff against its first parent.
Issues keyed `owner/repo#<number zero-padded 5>`; pull requests live in `pulls` and share the number sequence.
Single row `counters`: shared issue/pull/label id sequence, comment and review ids, commit sequence.
Pull requests keyed `owner/repo#<number zero-padded 5>` with computed commits, files and mergeability.
Repositories keyed by lower-cased `owner/name`; `next_number` is the shared issue and pull-request sequence.
Pull-request reviews keyed `owner/repo#<number>:<id zero-padded 10>`; the latest review per user decides approval.
Users and organisations keyed by lower-cased login. Read-only in this version.

connections.title: GitHub MCP server tool names (get_me, list_issues, issue_write, pull_request_read, ...)
connections.instructions: Connect a Streamable HTTP MCP client to GITHUB_MCP_URL with GITHUB_PERSONAL_ACCESS_TOKEN as a Bearer token. Eighteen tool names of the official GitHub MCP server are exposed as aliases next to the canonical github.<operation> names; results are the GitHub JSON objects.

connections.title: GitHub REST client (Octokit / gh-style base URL override)
connections.instructions: Point the client's baseUrl at GITHUB_API_URL and authenticate with GITHUB_TOKEN (sent as `Authorization: token ...` or `Bearer ...`); the value is the isolated world token, never a real personal access token. Only the documented route subset exists; every other GitHub path answers 404.
